citation.title: Ketone monoester supplementation during early recovery from exercise and the skeletal muscle transcriptome (placebo arm used)

population.description: Nine healthy, non-smoking, recreationally active men (>=3 endurance sessions per week, VO2max >= 40 mL/kg/min as enrolment criteria); age 26 ± 5 y (mean ± SD), height 1.80 ± 0.07 m, body mass 80 ± 9 kg, VO2max 47 ± 4 mL/kg/min. BMI not printed. Only the placebo (PLA) arm is entered; the ketone monoester (KME) arm is not.

protocols.name: bout_60pct_pla
protocols.description: Breakfast at arm minute 0 (30 min before exercise): 1 g/kg CHO, 0.1 g/kg PRO, 0.03 g/kg FAT x printed mean body mass 80 kg = 80 g carbohydrate, 8 g protein, 2.4 g fat. Cycling from minute 30 to 120 (90 min) at ~60% VO2max, placebo drink (water, bitter sucrose octaacetate, 5% w/v sucralose, strawberry flavour: no energy) at exercise min 45. Activity level from the measured placebo VO2, Table 1: mean of the six exercise values (2.31, 2.33, 2.37, 2.42, 2.41, 2.42 L/min) = 2.3767 L/min; / 80 kg (printed body mass) = 29.708 mL/kg/min; level = (29.708 - 3.7) / 31.7 = 0.8204. (The paper says participants exercised at ~63% of VO2max; 63% of the printed 47 mL/kg/min = 29.6, consistent.) The 30-min post-exercise recovery drink lies after the arm. The paper states no fast before the breakfast (participants 'arrived at the laboratory in the morning (0730 to 0830 h)'; the prepackaged diet is of the previous 24 h), so the arm starts from typical values (norm_center), not a fast; the clock hour 8.0 is assumed within the stated arrival window.

findings.description: Heart rate during the 90-min cycling bout at ~60% VO2max, placebo drink. Placebo arm. Each Table 1 value is the mean of the last 3 min of an exercise window (12-15, 27-30, 42-45, 57-60, 72-75, 87-90 min of exercise); the curve point is put at the last minute of that window (arm minutes 44, 59, 74, 89, 104, 119), the bout starting at arm minute 30.

location.where: Table 1, PLA row, columns 12-15, 27-30, 42-45, 57-60, 72-75, 87-90 min; HR (bpm); mean ± SD

Each Table 1 value is the mean of the last 3 min of an exercise window (12-15, 27-30, 42-45, 57-60, 72-75, 87-90 min of exercise); the curve point is put at the last minute of that window (arm minutes 44, 59, 74, 89, 104, 119), the bout starting at arm minute 30.

location.where: Table 1, PLA row, columns 12-15, 27-30, 42-45, 57-60, 72-75, 87-90 min; V̇CO2 (L·min−1); mean ± SD

left_out.what: serum glucose at the pre-exercise sample (PLA 4.8 ± 0.8 mM, n = 9, results text): whether the participants were fasted before the breakfast is not printed (and the sample is at arm minute 0)

respiratory exchange ratio during the bout (Table 1, PLA 0.93, 0.92, 0.91, 0.89, 0.88, 0.88 AU) and at rest: depends on the fed state before the breakfast, which the paper does not print (no fast stated)
ketone monoester (KME) arm of every table and figure
oxygen uptake during the bout (Table 1): used as the bout's intensity input, not entered as a finding
rest column of Table 1 (HR, lactate, RER, VCO2 at rest): the minute of the rest measurement relative to the breakfast is not printed
carbohydrate and fat oxidation in g/min (Table 1)
serum glucose, beta-hydroxybutyrate and erythropoietin during the 180-min recovery, and their total areas (Figure 2): numbers only in figures; PLA beta-hydroxybutyrate given only as '~ 0.1 mM'
muscle glycogen before and 180 min after exercise, in mmol/kg dry mass (Figure 3 and text)
